problem:
The probability distribution of the random variable $X$ is given below. Given that $\text{E}[X]=0,$ calculate $\text{Var}[2-\sqrt{10}X].$ 

| $x$ | $-1$ | $0$ | $1$ | $2$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $f(x)$ | $0.5$ | $0.1$ | $0.3$ | $0.1$ |

activity_context.topic_title: Properties of Variance for Discrete Random Variables

feedback.worked_solution:
Recall that for any random variable $X$ and constants $a$ and $b,$ we have

$$
\text{Var}[aX+b]={a}^{2}\cdot \text{Var}[X].
$$

In our case, $a=2$ and $b=3.$ Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{Var}[3+2X] & ={2}^{2}\cdot \text{Var}[X] \\  & =4\cdot 0.5 \\  & =2.\end{aligned}
$$
